# Improve a product workflow

Trace the primary task in the existing product. Identify the inputs, permissions, action,
result, and recovery path. If asked for a roadmap, list the observed problems in order of
impact on task completion. For each item give its location, evidence, and a concrete check
that would confirm a fix.

When asked to implement a particular item, keep the surrounding workflow intact. Check the
changed task with real controls and representative data. Include loading, empty, denied, and
failed states where the workflow supports them. Report the observed result and any states that
still need verification.
